arxiv-1508-00212.title: Procedural Content Generation for GDL Descriptions of Simplified Boardgames
arxiv-1508-00212.creator: Jakub Kowalski, Marek Szykuła
arxiv-1508-00212.description: Abstract We present initial research towards procedural generation of Simplified Boardgames and translating them into an efficient GDL code. This is a step towards establishing Simplified Boardgames as a comparison class for General Game Playing agents. To generate playable, human readable, and balanced chess-like games we use an adaptive evolutionary algorithm with the fitness function based on simulated playouts.

arxiv-1906-00337.title: Torsion braneworlds in a tensor-vector gravity
arxiv-1906-00337.creator: J. E. G. Silva, L. J. S. Sousa, W. T. Cruz, C.A.S. Almeida
arxiv-1906-00337.description: Abstract We study the properties of gravity and bulk fields living in a torsion warped braneworld. The torsion is driven by a background vector whose norm provides a source for the bulk cosmological constant. For a vector as the derivative of a scalar field, we find new isotropic thick brane geometry.

arxiv-2107-12136.description: Abstract This is part I of the follow-up lecture notes of the lectures given by the authors at the Three “CO” (Composability, Comprehensibility, Correctness) Winter School held in Košice, Slovakia, in January 2018, and Summer School held in Budapest, Hungary, in June 2019.

arxiv-2201-00026.title: From Chern-Tenenblat to Jackiw-Teitelboim via sine-Gordon
arxiv-2201-00026.creator: Jeff Murugan
arxiv-2201-00026.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jeff Murugan. The study of 2-dimensional surfaces of constant curvature constitutes a beautiful branch of geometry with well-documented ties to the mathematical physics of integrable systems. A lesser known, but equally fascinating, fact is its connection to 2-dimensional gravity; specifically Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity, where the connection manifests through a coordinate choice that roughly speaking re-casts the gravitational field equations as the sine-Gordon equation.

arxiv-2402-09428.creator: Yusong Liu 1, Ibrahim Abd El-Sadek 1, 2, Rion Morishita 1, Shuichi Makita 1, Tomoko Mori 3, Atsuko Furukawa 3, Satoshi Matsusaka 3 and Yoshiaki Yasuno 1,*, Yusong Liu 1, Ibrahim Abd El-Sadek 1, 2, Rion Morishita 1, Shuichi Makita 1, Tomoko Mori 3, Atsuko Furukawa 3, Satoshi Matsusaka 3 and Yoshiaki

LIV images from S2 data of Day-1 breast cancer (MCF-7) spheroids and Day-1 colon cancer (HT-29) spheroids are shown in Fig. S1 and S2 , respectively. LIV images from S1 and S2 data of Day-3 breast cancer (MCF-7) spheroids are shown in Fig.

arxiv-2505-20324.title: Evaluating the Energy-Efficiency of the Code Generated by LLMs
arxiv-2505-20324.creator: Md Arman Islam, Devi Varaprasad Jonnala, Ritika Rekhi
arxiv-2505-20324.description: Abstract As the quality of code generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) improves, their adoption in the software industry for automated code generation continues to grow. Researchers primarily focus on enhancing the functional correctness of the generated code while commonly overlooking its energy efficiency and environmental impact.

arxiv-2506-02679.title: Poster: FedBlockParadox - A Framework for Simulating and Securing Decentralized Federated Learning
arxiv-2506-02679.creator: Gabriele Digregorio, Francesco Bleggi, Federico Caroli, Michele Carminati, Stefano Zanero, Stefano Longari
arxiv-2506-02679.description: Abstract A significant body of research in decentralized federated learning focuses on combining the privacy-preserving properties of federated learning with the resilience and transparency offered by blockchain-based systems. While these approaches are promising, they often lack flexible tools to evaluate system robustness under adversarial conditions.

arxiv-2511-02158.title: Asset-liability management with Epstein-Zin utility under stochastic interest rate and unknown market price of risk Thanks: This work was supported by a grant from the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences, with financial support from the Government of Canada, provided through Global Affairs C
arxiv-2511-02158.creator: Wilfried Kuissi-Kamdem
arxiv-2511-02158.description: Abstract . This paper solves a consumption-investment choice problem with Epstein–Zin recursive utility under partial information—unobservable market price of risk. The main novelty is the introduction of a terminal liability constraint, a feature directly motivated by practical portfolio management and insurance applications but absent from the recursive-utility literature.

arxiv-2601-15428.title: Supernova interactions with aspherical circumstellar material I: calculations of light curves, AB magnitudes, spectra, and polarisation
arxiv-2601-15428.creator: P. Kurfürst, G. Bless, J. Fišák, F. Holoubek, J. Krtička, B. Kubátová, J. Kubát, M. Zajaček
arxiv-2601-15428.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by P. Kurfürst, G. Bless, J. Fišák, F. Holoubek, J. Krtička, B. Kubátová, J. Kubát, M. Zajaček. We present an upgraded detailed numerical calculations of supernova (SN) interactions with significantly aspherical circumstellar matter (CSM), primarily formed as a disc or bipolar lobes. The circumstellar disc can arise as a result of, for example, mass transfer in a binary, while bipolar lobes can be the result of a violent pre-explosive ejection of matter, similar to the iconic cases of luminous blue variable stars (LBVs).

plos-pone-0010666.title: Potent Cardioprotective Effect of the 4-Anilinoquinazoline Derivative PD153035: Involvement of Mitochondrial K ATP Channel Activation
plos-pone-0010666.creator: Renata A. Cavalheiro, Rodrigo M. Marin, Silvana A. Rocco et al.
plos-pone-0010666.description: PLOS ONE research article. The aim of the present study was to evaluate the protective effects of the 4-anilinoquinazoline derivative PD153035 on cardiac ischemia/reperfusion and mitochondrial function. Perfused rat hearts and cardiac HL-1 cells were used to determine cardioprotective effects of PD153035.

pmc-10621857.title: Chimpanzees make tactical use of high elevation in territorial contexts
pmc-10621857.creator: Sylvain R. T. Lemoine, Liran Samuni, Catherine Crockford, Roman M. Wittig, Roland G Roberts, Roland G Roberts, Roland G Roberts, Roland G Roberts
pmc-10621857.description: Tactical warfare is considered a driver of the evolution of human cognition. One such tactic, considered unique to humans, is collective use of high elevation in territorial conflicts. This enables early detection of rivals and low-risk maneuvers, based on information gathered. Whether other animals use such tactics is unknown.

pmc-10653610.title: Hepatic macrophages play critical roles in the establishment and growth of hydatid cysts in the liver during Echinococcus granulosus sensu stricto infection
pmc-10653610.creator: Hui Wang, Qian Yu, Mingkun Wang, Jiao Hou, Maolin Wang, Xuejiao Kang, Xinling Hou, Dewei Li, Zibigu Rousu, Tiemin Jiang, Jing Li, Hao Wen, Chuanshan Zhang, Delia Goletti, Uriel Koziol, Delia Goletti, Uriel Koziol, Delia Goletti, Uriel Koziol
pmc-10653610.description: Cystic echinococcosis (CE) is a worldwide neglected zoonotic disease caused by infection with the larval stage of the tapeworm Echinococcus granulosus sensu lato (E. granulosus s.l.), which predominantly resides in the liver accompanied by mild inflammation. Macrophages constitute the main cellular component of the liver and play a central role in controlling the progression of inflammation and liver fibrosis.

pmc-11470074.title: Energy transfer-mediated multiphoton synergistic excitation for selective C(sp3)–H functionalization with coordination polymer
pmc-11470074.creator: Zhonghe Wang, Yang Tang, Songtao Liu, Liang Zhao, Huaqing Li, Cheng He, Chunying Duan
pmc-11470074.description: Activation and selective oxidation of inert C(sp3)–H bonds remain one of the most challenging tasks in current synthetic chemistry due to the inherent inertness of C(sp3)–H bonds. In this study, inspired by natural monooxygenases, we developed a coordination polymer with naphthalenediimide (NDI)-based ligands and binuclear iron nodes.

pmc-11478148.title: Characterization and Crystal Structural Analysis of Novel Carvedilol Adipate and Succinate Ethanol-Solvated Salts
pmc-11478148.creator: Li Ye, Takayuki Furuishi, Takefumi Yamashita, Etsuo Yonemochi
pmc-11478148.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Two ethanol-solvated adipate and succinate salts of carvedilol (CVD), a Biopharmaceutics Classification System class 2 drug, were synthesized by crystallizing ethanol with adipic acid (ADP) and succinic acid (SUA). Proton transfer from ADP and SUA to CVD and the presence of ethanol in the two novel compounds were confirmed using powder X-ray diffraction, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements.

pmc-11508391.title: The Aspergillus flavus hacA Gene in the Unfolded Protein Response Pathway Is a Candidate Target for Host-Induced Gene Silencing
pmc-11508391.creator: Perng-Kuang Chang
pmc-11508391.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fungal HacA/Hac1 transcription factors play a crucial role in regulating the unfolded protein response (UPR). The UPR helps cells to maintain endoplasmic reticulum (ER) protein homeostasis, which is critical for growth, development, and virulence. The Aspergillus flavus hacA gene encodes a domain rich in basic and acidic amino acids (Bsc) and a basic leucine zipper (bZip) domain, and features a non-conventional intron (Nt20).

pmc-11635714.title: Redox-sensitive epigenetic activation of SUV39H1 contributes to liver ischemia-reperfusion injury
pmc-11635714.creator: Zilong Li, Jichen Li, Meng Wu, Zexin Li, Jiawen Zhou, Yunjie Lu, Yong Xu, Lei Qin, Zhiwen Fan
pmc-11635714.description: Liver ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury is a clinically relevant pathophysiological process that determines the effectiveness of life-saving liver transplantation, to which aberrant ROS accumulation plays a key role. In the present study we investigated the role of SUV39H1, a lysine methyltransferases, in this process focusing on regulatory mechanism and translational potential.

pmc-12589687.title: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt with ePTFE-covered stentgrafts: incidence and predictors of shunt dysfunction
pmc-12589687.creator: Michael B Pitton, Lukas Müller, Fabian Stoehr, Arndt Weinmann, Christian Labenz, Jens Mittler, Roman Kloeckner, Christoph Düber, Gerd Otto
pmc-12589687.description: ObjectivesTo analyze revision rates after transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) using expanded polytetrafluoroethylene-covered stentgrafts and to identify predictors of shunt revisions.Materials and methodsThis single-center retrospective study included 514 consecutive patients (mean age 56.9 ± 12.7 years; 194 females) with TIPS placement between 2003 and 2021. Follow-up included clinical assessment, laboratory testing, ultrasound, and computed tomography.

pmc-13053729.title: Hypoalbuminemia induces immunosuppression through disorder in macrophages and drives resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors
pmc-13053729.creator: Fan Yang, Yaping Long, Yao Li, Yibing Bai, Yining Liu, Dingyuan Cheng, Tao Li, Yiheng Lu, Xiao Han, Yi Hu
pmc-13053729.description: Hypoalbuminemia is a common clinical biomarker associated with poor outcomes in cancer patients. While it correlates with resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), the direct functional role and underlying mechanisms in driving immunotherapy resistance remain unclear. In our study, we demonstrated that hypoalbuminemia directly drives ICIs resistance by orchestrating an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) through impaired macrophage arginine metabolism.

pmc-13183752.title: The effect of Poller screw or monocortical plate augmentation on the stability of intramedullary nailing in proximal extra-articular tibial fractures: a biomechanical study
pmc-13183752.creator: Mehmet Akif Şahin, Fatih Durgut, Şeyhmus Yiğit, Mehmet Sait Akar, Emin Özkul, Ramazan Atiç, Sadettin Çiftçi
pmc-13183752.description: BackgroundProximal extra-articular tibial fractures present considerable biomechanical and technical challenges due to the short proximal fragment, the wide metaphyseal canal, and the deforming forces acting around the knee. These factors predispose isolated intramedullary (IM) nailing to malalignment, prompting the use of adjunct reduction aids such as Poller screws or supplemental plates.

pmc-13211318.title: Shared decision-making in prostate cancer treatment: selecting an androgen deprivation therapy option
pmc-13211318.creator: Sean P. Collins, Martine C. Maculaitis, Marty Chakoian
pmc-13211318.description: This podcast will provide an overview of androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) for advanced prostate cancer, including the different treatment options currently available. The podcast will also cover the key results of recently published studies that looked at patient preferences for different characteristics of ADT.

pmc-13268996.title: Expanding the role of insulin resistance to the earliest phases of cognitive decline: Preliminary evidence
pmc-13268996.creator: Salvatore Mazzeo, Arianna Frijo, Maria Vittoria Corbari, Elisa Bortolin, Giulia Bruschi, Alessandro Bombaci, Federico Emanuele Pozzi, Alberto Astengo, Francesca Magrì, Antonio Pettinato, Elena Costa, Massimo Filippi, Maria Salsone
pmc-13268996.description: ding to systemic metabolic dysfunction. 1 A growing body of evidence identifies brain IR as a key mechanistic link between metabolic dysfunction and neurodegeneration, particularly Alzheimer's disease (AD). 2 Experimental and clinical studies suggest that impaired insulin signaling may promote amyloid accumulation, tau phosphorylation, synaptic dysfunction, and neuroinflammation, thereby contributing to AD pathophysiology.

pmc-13302278.title: Protocol for Developing and Validating a Multimarker-Clinical Prediction Model of SGLT2 Inhibitor-Induced Acute eGFR Dip in CKD Stages 3–4: A Three-Stage Urinary Proteomics Study
pmc-13302278.creator: Zhiyu Duan, Youhe Gao, Mengjie Huang, Yanjun Liang, Jing Hao, Jie Wang, Guangyan Cai
pmc-13302278.description: Introduction: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce renal composite endpoints and proteinuria, yet RCTs uniformly show an acute eGFR dip within 2 weeks to 2 months after initiation. However, demographic and clinical predictors of an acute eGFR dip demonstrate considerable heterogeneity across studies.

pmc-13336123.title: Imaging‐Guided Live Single‐Cell Lipid Profiling of Leader and Follower Cells During Collective Migration of Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-13336123.creator: Xiaoyue Huang, Judit González Riera, Mai Nguyen, Jeremy Broekhuis, Sylvia E Le Dévédec, Ahmed Ali, Thomas Hankemeier
pmc-13336123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Leader and follower cells drive collective cancer cell migration through distinct and interactive roles, but their specific metabolic signatures remain largely unknown. Here, we developed and applied a workflow that integrates time‐lapse imaging, single‐cell tracking, microsampling and direct infusion high‐resolution mass spectrometry to profile the lipidomes of individually sampled leader and follower cells from highly migratory TNBC lines HCC1143 and HCC38.

pmc-13411279.title: A transposable element-derived regulatory variation in RsOFP2.3 underlies morphological diversification of radish taproots through the conserved OVATE family protein-TONNEAU1-recruiting motif module
pmc-13411279.creator: Yanping Wang, Xiangyu Wu, Yuanting Pang, Dingzhu Hua, Ting Chi, Ailing Ge, Tongbing Su, Qingbiao Wang, Li Zhang
pmc-13411279.description: Radish (Raphanus sativus L.) represents a major root vegetable crop exhibiting remarkable variation in taproot morphology, yet the underlying genetic and molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through a structural variant (SV)-based genome-wide association study (GWAS), we identified RsOFP2.3, encoding an OVATE Family Protein (OFP), as a major determinant of fleshy taproot shape.

pmc-13448534.title: READYCOM: protocol for a 2-year prospective natural history and cross-sectional muscle-fatigability study for improving trial readiness in congenital myopathies
pmc-13448534.creator: Sanne A J H van de Camp, Roosmarijn Brenninkmeijer, Jeroen L M van Doorn, Elisabeth C M de Laat, Lisa Pomp, Lizan Stinissen, Donnie Cameron, Jan T Groothuis, Nens van Alfen, Heinz Jungbluth, Corrie E Erasmus, Bart Bartels, Renske I Wadman, Nicoline B M Voet, W Ludo van der Pol, Nicol C Voermans
pmc-13448534.description: IntroductionCongenital myopathies (CMYO) are a group of rare hereditary muscle diseases defined by characteristic abnormalities on muscle biopsy. Several types, including the core myopathies central core disease and multi-minicore disease, nemaline myopathy and centronuclear myopathy, have been identified based on the characteristic histopathological changes and attributed to various genetic backgrounds.

pmc-13556541.title: 650. Anxiolytic effects of serotoninergic psychedelics on patients with psychiatric disorders
pmc-13556541.creator: R Freire, C Chaves, M Cabo, J Mojgani, E Brietzke, C Svab, F Buono, A Garakani
pmc-13556541.description: BackgroundAnxiety disorders are among the most prevalent psychiatric disorders worldwide, causing significant impacts on physical and emotional health and substantial functional impairment. Not only individuals with anxiety disorders have severe and debilitating anxiety symptoms; patients with PTSD, OCD and mood disorders often present with anxiety.

pmc-13577009.title: Synergistic anti-obesity effects of Bifidobacterium breve BR3 and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP3 via coordinated regulation of lipid metabolism and gut microbiota
pmc-13577009.creator: Misun Yun, Dooheon Son, Namhee Kim, Se Hee Lee, Eunbee Cho, Sanghyun Lim
pmc-13577009.description: The global rise in obesity and its associated metabolic complications underscores the urgent need for safe and effective interventions. This study investigated the anti-obesity efficacy of a probiotic mixture containing Bifidobacterium breve BR3 and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP3 in C57BL/6 mice with high-fat diet (HFD)-induced obesity.

pmc-13606031.title: Consumer Behavior Toward Andean Grains Among Young Peruvian Adults: Purchase Patterns, Motivations, and Barriers Across Cultural Contexts
pmc-13606031.creator: Dany Yudet Millones-Liza, Elizabeth Emperatriz García-Salirrosas, Manuel Escobar-Farfán, Iván Veas-González, Manuel Amasifuen-Reategui, Esther Olivia Acosta-Miraval
pmc-13606031.description: Andean grains, such as quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.), kiwicha (Amaranthus caudatus), cañihua (Chenopodium pallidicaule Aellen), and tarwi (Lupinus mutabilis Sweet), represent a nutritional and cultural heritage of paramount importance to Peru; however, their regular consumption remains limited despite widespread recognition of their beneficial properties.

pmc-13683519.title: Psychotropic drugs in drinking water? A scoping review of evidence on diazepam and fluoxetine
pmc-13683519.creator: Paula Pinheiro Teixeira, Beatriz Assunção Pereira, Roberta da Silva Carneiro, Lara Júlia Moraes de Assis, Mariana Luiza Leal, Matheus Marcon
pmc-13683519.description: The global prevalence of mental disorders has increased considerably in recent decades. This evidence, associated with population growth and the expansion of access to medications, favors the growing global consumption of psychotropic drugs. Consequently, an increasing load of these substances is introduced into the environment, especially into water bodies, characterizing them as emerging contaminants.
